title: Add triage action with complexity classification
userStory: As a developer, I want Triage to analyze and recommend a path so that I can make an informed decision.
acceptanceCriteria: Send to Triage button on Draft task cards triggers analysis job
Triage analyzes: scope, file count, ambiguity, estimated changes
Triage returns: complexity assessment, scope analysis, recommended path (simple|feature), reasoning
Task stays in Triage state showing results
User sees two buttons: 'Proceed as Simple Task' or 'Send to Planning'
User can also 'Back to Draft' to edit before deciding
No auto-routing - task waits for user action
User can override classification before proceeding
